name: Duma
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game animation atlas. Create exactly TWELVE SMALL isolated sprites in four equal columns and three rows, total 12. A single coherent primitive fantasy character, 3/4 right facing, painted pixel-art clusters, natural adult proportions and dark readable contours, matching the craft of the style reference. First row: four subtly different breathing idle poses. Second row: four genuinely different in-place walking poses with alternating left and right foot contact. Third row: anticipation, compact action, impact, recovery. IMPORTANT layout: figures must be TINY, head to foot only 16% of canvas height (half the height of each row). Each whole figure, entire weapon and all effects fit inside central 60% of the column width. Abundant transparent empty space around all 12 figures, no overlap, no clipping, every weapon short or foreshortened to remain compact. Feet at 80% of each cell height, body scale consistent across all poses. Canvas square with RGBA transparency. No words, no frame boxes, no scenery, no ground, no shadow under characters. Primitive fiber, hides, wood, bone, stone; no modern or medieval knight clothing. Each row contains exactly four fully visible figures; same costume, face, palette, body proportions across every frame. Reference image is STYLE only; do not copy its identity or props. 
NEW CHARACTER: Duma, Matriarca do Marfim, ONE STAR. Canonical appearance: líder alta e robusta carregando um enorme bastão e grandes adornos claros nos ombros.. Female tribal matriarch with warm dark-brown skin, strong mature face, dark hair tied in thick braids, tall powerful body. Compact staff guarding and shoving strike, faint ivory protection spark only at impact. Traits: Manada, Guardião, Espírito do Elefante. Ability inspiration: Chamado da Matriarca: protege aliados e empurra inimigos.. This is the base human form: exclude traits that only belong to evolutions two and three. Do not add animal anatomy unless explicitly in the canonical base description.
